title: Melter 1, Melter 2, fill, lid, swab, export, and shipment remain separate asset and container stages
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE records support separate registry nodes for both LAW melters and for fill, lid and exterior swab, export-bay handoff, reusable transport sleeve, and shipment; no public record supplies a stable container-level join across them. Denominator: Two named melter assets and five post-melter container lifecycle or handoff stages.
